Merger Agreement: SECTION 9.2. Evaluation of Competing Offers. <omitted> (c) Notwithstanding any provision in this Agreement to the contrary, at any time prior to the Effective Time, the Company Board may make a Company Recommendation Change if, and only if, (i) the Company Board determines in good faith, after consultation with the Company’s outside legal counsel and a financial advisor of nationally recognized reputation, that the failure to make the Company Recommendation Change would be inconsistent with the fiduciary duties of the Company Board under applicable Law, (ii) the Company has given Parent written notice of the Company Board’s intention to make a Company Recommendation Change not later than 11:59 p.m. New York time on the fourth Business Day after Parent receives such written notice, and (iii) the Company Board has determined that such competing offer is a Superior Proposal, considering factors such as regulatory approval likelihood, the impact on employees and other stakeholders, in addition to the financial terms of the proposal.
